summary.key_theme: 受惠於 AI 需求與資料中心擴張帶動的強勁成長動能，Quanta Services 獲得華爾街分析師正面評價與目標價調升。

bullish.title: Piper Sandler Initiates Coverage On Quanta Services with Overweight Rating, Announces Price Target of $731
bullish.reason: Piper Sandler 分析師 Dimple Gosai 給予「加碼」評級，並設定 731 美元目標價，顯示機構投資人對其未來成長潛力的高度信心。

bullish.title: 5 Top-Ranked Growth Stocks to Strengthen Your Portfolio in September
bullish.reason: 報告指出 AI 驅動的需求、創紀錄的積壓訂單以及資料中心擴張，使 PWR 成為具備強勁成長動能的投資標的。

bullish.title: Is Quanta Services Stock Outperforming the S&P 500?
bullish.reason: PWR 在過去一年表現顯著優於 S&P 500 指數，且華爾街對其後市看法持續保持高度樂觀。

bullish.title: Ellen Rubin Joins Quanta Services Board of Directors
bullish.reason: 任命 Ellen Rubin 加入董事會，有助於強化公司治理結構與策略指導。

bullish.title: Here’s How Much You Would Have Made Owning Quanta Services Stock In The Last 15 Years

bullish.title: Quanta Services (PWR) Rises As Market Takes a Dip: Key Facts
bullish.reason: 在市場整體回調時逆勢上漲 2.34%，顯示該股具備較強的抗跌性與市場買盤支撐。

bullish.title: Wall Street Analysts See Quanta Services (PWR) as a Buy: Should You Invest?

bearish.title: Quanta Services (PWR) Stock Trades At A Premium To Fair Value
bearish.reason: 分析指出儘管公司績效強勁，但目前股價已高於公允價值，暗示短期內可能存在估值過高的風險。

neutral.title: Is Rising Analyst Optimism Around PWR’s Dividend Sharpening Quanta’s Grid Expansion Investment Case?
